# load tsv and prolific raw data
```{r}
gitrepo_path = "/Users/momocco/Documents/GitHub/srndna-ug/behavioral_analyses"

data_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"data", sep = "/")
```

# load data
```{r}
rej_rate_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, "rej_rate_partner_50.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)

# sub_remove = c("sub-120","sub-131","sub-145")
# rej_rate_df = rej_rate_df[!rej_rate_df$subjID %in% sub_remove,]

# load L3 subs as in L3 template
L3_plain_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, "participant_L3_47.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)

participant_check_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, "participant_check.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)
```

# combine data frame using the subject order in L3_plain
```{r}
rej_rate_L3_df = L3_plain_df
rej_colnames = colnames(rej_rate_df)[-1]
rej_rate_L3_df[, c("age", rej_colnames)] = NA
for (i in 1:nrow(L3_plain_df)) {
  sub_i = L3_plain_df$subjID[i]
  rej_rate_L3_df[i,rej_colnames] = rej_rate_df[rej_rate_df$subjID == sub_i, rej_colnames]
  rej_rate_L3_df$age[i] = participant_check_df$age[participant_check_df$participant_id == sub_i]
}

rej_rate_L3_df = rej_rate_L3_df %>% 
  mutate(
    # age_mean = age - mean(age),
         young = case_when(age <=36 ~ 1,
                           age > 36 ~ 0),
         old = case_when(age <=36 ~ 0,
                           age > 36 ~ 1),
         in_out = ingroup_rej_rate - outgroup_rej_rate,
         in_out_demean = in_out - mean(in_out),
         in_computer = ingroup_rej_rate - computer_rej_rate,
         in_computer_demean = in_computer - mean(in_computer),
         out_computer = outgroup_rej_rate - computer_rej_rate,
         out_computer_demean = out_computer - mean(out_computer)
  )
```

# construct different L3 cov and save
## in_out_age_bi_df
```{r}
in_out_age_bi_df = rej_rate_L3_df %>% 
  mutate(in_out_young = in_out_demean*young,
         in_out_old = in_out_demean*old) %>% 
  select(subjID, ismale, tsnr, fd_mean, RT, 
         young, old,
         in_out_young, in_out_old)
write.csv(in_out_age_bi_df, paste(data_dir, "in_out_age_rej.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## in_computer_age_bi_df
```{r}
in_computer_age_bi_df = rej_rate_L3_df %>% 
  mutate(in_computer_young = in_computer_demean*young,
         in_computer_old = in_computer_demean*old) %>% 
  select(subjID, ismale, tsnr, fd_mean, RT, 
         young, old,
         in_computer_young, in_computer_old)
write.csv(in_computer_age_bi_df, paste(data_dir, "in_computer_age_rej.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## out_computer_age_bi_df
```{r}
out_computer_age_bi_df = rej_rate_L3_df %>% 
  mutate(out_computer_young = out_computer_demean*young,
         out_computer_old = out_computer_demean*old) %>% 
  select(subjID, ismale, tsnr, fd_mean, RT, 
         young, old,
         out_computer_young, out_computer_old)
write.csv(out_computer_age_bi_df, paste(data_dir, "out_computer_age_rej.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
